regime.summary: The market is weak. BTC is below its 50 day average and above its 200 day average, and 13% of coins are above their 50 day average. Most breakouts fail even in good markets, so in a weak market protecting cash matters more than finding a winner. Today there is 1 signal. If you act, act only on those: read the caution flags, size so a stop out costs about 1% of your capital, and note the sell level. Should you invest at all? Only money you can afford to lose completely, and only after a few weeks of paper trading these signals.
